basic_details.job_title: JIPMER Project Technician II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER) is recruiting candidates for 1 vacancy for the post of Project Technician II on a contract basis for an externally sponsored project. The position is time-bound for a period of 1 year, with a likely duration of 6 months. Candidates must possess a B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology from a recognized University, and the notified consolidated remuneration is Rs. 23,600 per month. Eligible applicants can apply online by completing the application process and uploading self-attested required documents in PDF format on or

how_to_apply: Access the online application link provided below.
Fill out the application form completely and ensure it is in the prescribed format.

Prepare self-attested documents in PDF format (less than or equal to 1MB each) including the 10th mark sheet for date of birth, community certificate, passport size photo in JPEG format, UG degree certificate as one file, and a detailed CV file including UG, OGPA/CGPA, work experience with dates, technical skills, and two references.
Submit the application online on or before 23 October 2026, Friday before 04:30 PM.
Applicants wishing to apply for two or more different posts must fill out a separate application form for each post and submit them in separate emails or submissions with necessary enclosures.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technician II at a Glance

rows.details: Jawaharlal Institute of Postgraduate Medical Education and Research (JIPMER)
Enhancing Infectious Disease Diagnosis Quality: External Quality Assurance Program
6 Months (Time-bound for a period of 1 year)
Maximum 28 years (as on last date of receipt of applications)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential qualification requirements specified in the notification to be eligible for the post of Project Technician II. Essential Qualification: B.Sc. Medical Laboratory Technology from a recognized University. Desirable Qualifications: One-year work experience in molecular techniques especially in handling clinical sample and ELISA, and knowledge of Computer Applications. Age Limit: Maximum Age Limit is 28 years as on the last date of receipt of applications. Age relaxation applies to various categories in accordance with GOI instructions.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Project Technician II
content_sections.text: Access the online application link provided below. Fill out the application form completely and ensure it is in the prescribed format. Prepare self-attested documents in PDF format (less than or equal to 1MB each) including the 10th mark sheet for date of birth, community certificate, passport size photo in JPEG format, UG degree certificate as one file, and a detailed CV file including UG, OGPA/CGPA, work experience with dates, technical skills, and two references. Submit the application online on or before 23 October 2026, Friday before 04:30 PM. Applicants wishing to apply for two or more different posts must fill out a separate application form for each post and submit them in separate emails or submissions with necessary enclosures.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will receive an email notification regarding the online screening test. Candidates applying offline or via hardcopy will not be considered. Shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. The written test consists of 80 marks at a B.Sc. level with no negative marking. The interview carries 20 marks. Interviews may be conducted in person or via videoconferencing at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

faq.question: Q1. Is the JIPMER Project Technician II position permanent?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely on a contract basis for an externally sponsored project and persons engaged will have no claim to any regular post in JIPMER at any time.

faq.question: Q2. Are any allowances paid in addition to the consolidated salary?
faq.answer: No other allowances are payable apart from the consolidated remuneration of Rs. 23,600/- per month, which includes 20000 plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable to various categories in accordance with Government of India (GOI) instructions, subject to a maximum age limit of 28 years.

faq.question: Q4. How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates will receive email notifications regarding an online screening test, and shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview based on details furnished in the application, CV, and documentary proof.
